_help: Nova's dialogs. Each line: text (required), expression (see nova.json: neutral, happy, excited, sad, confused, surprised, angry, curious, worried, smug, content, laughing), body (arm-down | wave | point), showPoints (true = reveal + highlight the points counter), button (label of a button shown on that line). Placeholders: {name} {goal} {points}.

intro.text: Hi there! I’m {name}, an intern scientist from NASA.
I’m so lucky to have gotten this job! I just LOVE learning about humanity’s space endeavors, especially all the technology that helped make it happen!
It’s a real shame though… a lot of the tech we used was left behind and almost forgotten.
Actually, will you join me to explore space and learn more about this forgotten equipment?
To complete our exploration, I’ve set us a goal of research points.
After we learn about each piece of equipment, you’ll gain some research points. Reach {goal}, and we’ll finish.
With that in mind, let's start exploring!

bonusUnlocked.text: We made it! The Moon and Mars, all visited!
Huh? I’m getting another signal from something way in the distance…
Isn’t that…? Let’s check it out before we head home.

ending.text: I… think that’s all! For real this time!
I can’t thank you enough for joining me on this journey. I’ve learned so much alongside you, and I hope you’ve learned as well.
Again, thank you so so much! Until we meet again!

credits.heading: Thank you for exploring!
credits.note: NASA Space Apps Challenge · Abandoned but not Forgotten
